deviations.reason: Fully reproduced for command-gate-out.sh's rc==6 branch (c) by running the pre-Phase-3 committed file against the exact Case 1 fixture in an isolated scratch copy (outside the real working tree): confirmed it wrongly promotes the self-attributed task (2 update-task-status.sh calls instead of 1).
